notes.title: We’re excited to announce a major update!
notes.notes:
Hello, friends!
We've been working hard to improve the game, and we're excited to announce a major update that includes:
•	New levels and the story finale – Discover how the protagonist’s journey ends.
•	New type of enemies – Now opponents are armed with firearms.
•	Revamped main menu – Stylish, user-friendly, and atmospheric.
•	Rewritten dialogues.
•	Reworked locations.
•	Terminal puzzles.
•	Numerous bug fixes and many other improvements!
But that's not all — we’re not stopping here! In the upcoming builds, you can look forward to:
•	Enhanced combat system – Battles will become even more dynamic and spectacular.
•	Advanced enemy AI – Enemies will be more aggressive and dangerous.
•	Rage mechanic.
•	New abilities.
•	More puzzles.
Stay tuned, share your feedback, and don't miss the upcoming updates!

notes.title: The Global Update
notes.notes:
We welcome everyone!

We decided to listen to your comments and release a global update that fixes a number of aspects:

Firstly, we have redesigned the board control system at the 6th and 14th locations. Now you have to drive a gravity car with good control.

We also removed a number of unnecessary cutscenes (camera spans) on the 2nd level.

Finally, the dialogue system has been fixed. Now extra buttons with empty answer options are not displayed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38134973/bf2bf49fb437665529ca6ab3d1a1cd55c5d0ce4c.png[/img]

notes.title: Game Release
notes.notes:
Hello dear players!

Finally, we are pleased to present to you the long-awaited update along with the exit from Early Access.

Combat sounds have been added to the game, and a number of technical issues have been fixed.

We wish everyone a pleasant gameplay!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38134973/5148204c8a01e95da92e6290e1c9648d57c8c1da.png[/img]

notes.title: Global Storyline Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We are releasing a global update with the end of the storyline. However, that's not all! Ahead of you awaits the final update with the sounds of the battle, localizations and fixes for a number of problems. This will happen very soon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38134973/58fa7a64fe8907406bd41f86eae3b0b617605fec.png[/img]

notes.title: The Global Update (May)
notes.notes:
To a world where values and morals make one last attempt to keep up with technology
Privatized police and electronic shadows wandering through abandoned infrastructure await you.
At your service are smarter machines that have decided to judge their creators.

We present to your attention a new update with a continuation of the storyline.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38134973/82cf54a80850ff463c6de9d536268d8a20453771.png[/img]

notes.title: The Global Update (April)
notes.notes:
The action-packed cyberpunk drama continues ...

«She was special. She had congenital synesthesia – a multisensory perception syndrome. Your bosses confirmed your choice was good: apart from synesthesia, she had a suitable education and work experience in hacking, which made her the perfect candidate for living in both worlds. They ordered you to “tame” her.»

In this update, you will find two completely new game locations and unexpected plot moments. Hurry up to purchase The Divine Invasion.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38134973/c667144805dd83ee95add37d694da69744debadc.png[/img]

notes.title: Quality update (March)
notes.notes:
A small update, which added 2 new locations.
One will already be familiar to you, and the second is slightly updated.
There will be no action here, the emphasis is on story and dialogue.
Enjoy the game everyone!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38134973/bf2bf49fb437665529ca6ab3d1a1cd55c5d0ce4c.png[/img]

notes.title: A global update - Level number 11
notes.notes:
Dear Friends, today a new update was released!
A continuation of the exciting story awaits you, this time from the third person.
We hope that you managed to evaluate the previous update, where the main character shows his "real self".
Well, and a small gift - we will publish a series of mini-announcements in the form of a comic, where the plot of the current update is briefly revealed (without spoilers).
We wish everyone a pleasant game!
